prompts.style: Photographic: gritty 35mm press photo, documentary reality suits the deadpan
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 medium close-up, documentary press photograph on 35mm film with visible grain. A plain middle-aged white man with thinning grey-brown hair, tired eyes and a navy suit with a loosened blue tie stands knee-deep in scattered banknotes on a damp lawn, looking straight into the lens with a flat, expressionless, deadpan stare. Overcast flat daylight, slightly harsh on-camera flash. Behind him, softly out of focus, two bare trees, each with a blank wooden plaque hanging from a branch, no writing at all. A few notes still flutter in the air. Muted, slightly desaturated colour, ordinary and unglamorous, no logos, no text. Thanks.

prompts.style: Painted: 1930s gouache political poster, flat colour and bold shapes make the satire iconic
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 illustrated composition in the style of a 1930s gouache propaganda poster, flat matte colour, bold simplified shapes, visible brush texture, limited palette of mustard, teal and brick red. A middle-aged man in a dark suit, plain face, receding hair, stands chest-up in a drift of green banknotes, turning his head to stare directly at the viewer with a dry, unimpressed look. Behind him two stylised trees stand side by side, each with an empty blank plaque, one heavy with money. Strong diagonal light, thick outlines, generous negative space at the top. No lettering, no logos. Thanks.

prompts.style: Stop-motion paper-cut diorama: handmade tactile craft, comic and unlike either other
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 macro photograph of a handmade stop-motion diorama made of cut card, felt and crumpled paper. A small puppet of a middle-aged man in a grey felt suit, round plain face with painted dot eyes and a flat mouth, stands among tiny paper banknotes piled around his feet, his head turned to face the camera head-on, deadpan. Behind him two paper-craft trees on a tabletop set, each with a blank cardboard plaque. Warm practical studio lamp, shallow depth of field, visible fingerprints and glue seams, tilt-shift softness. No text, no logos. Thanks.
